summary_en: Annual dividend raised to ¥50/share (¥25 interim + ¥25 final) from ¥40 forecast. Prior year FY3/26: ¥35 (¥15 interim + ¥20 final). Total payout ~¥343M. Interim and final each increased ¥5/share. Triggered by upward earnings revision: H1 FY3/27 operating profit +106%, full-year operating profit +33%.
title_en: Notice on Revision of Consolidated Business Performance Forecast for Q2 (Interim Period) and Full Year FY3/27, and Revision of Interim and Final Dividend Forecasts (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: On 10 August 2026, Cominix's board approved an upward revision of consolidated and standalone earnings forecasts for FY3/27 (fiscal year ending 31 March 2027) and a corresponding increase in dividend guidance. The company raised its full-year dividend per share from ¥40 (comprising ¥20 interim + ¥20 final) to ¥50 (¥25 interim + ¥25 final), an increase of ¥5 per share in both interim and final payments. The prior full-year dividend for FY3/26 was ¥35 (¥15 interim + ¥20 final). Total dividend payout is projected at approximately ¥343 million. The raise follows a strong H1 performance: operating profit surged 407.7% year-on-year to ¥682 million in the first quarter (ended 30 June 2026), driven by demand from cutting-tool customers ahead of planned price hikes and robust semiconductor-equipment-related orders in the KMS segment. Full-year operating profit is now forecast at ¥1,600 million (revised up from ¥1,200 million), a 33% increase. Earnings per share for the full year are projected at ¥160.15, compared to the prior forecast of ¥116.47. The company states that shareholder profit returns are a key management objective, and the dividend increase reflects both the upward earnings revision and its capital-allocation policy.
